The petitioners claim to be the owners of R.S. Plot  No. 562, 481, 481/1219, 481/1220, 496, 558 in Mouza  Kodalia and R.S. Plot No. 735/1454 in Mouza Bisharpara  which was sought to be acquired for the purpose of  construction of Nowai Basin Drainage Scheme by  initiating a requisition proceeding being Land Acquisition  Case No. LA-II/18 of 1967-68 by issuing a notice under  Section 3(a) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and  Acquisition Act), 1948.

sentences.text: Mr. Mukherjee, learned advocate appearing for the  petitioners submits that Co-ordinate Benches have  directed payment of compensation to the persons whose  property was utilized for the purpose of the said project.

Plot No. 735/1454 in Mouza Bisharpara  which was sought to be acquired for the purpose of  construction of Nowai Basin Drainage Scheme by  initiating a requisition proceeding being Land Acquisition  Case No. LA-II/18 of 1967-68 by issuing a notice under  Section 3(a) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and  Acquisition Act), 1948.
opennyai_summary.decision:
2  The Special Land Acquisition Officer, North 24 Parganas being the 4th respondent is directed to file a report in the form of an affidavit with regard to the allegations contained in the writ petition specifically stating as to whether the plots of land of the petitioners was the subject matter of the aforesaid requisition proceeding and/or the same was utilized for the said project.
The report in the form of an affidavit shall be filed by the said respondent on 13th January, 2026 after serving an advance copy of the same to the learned advocate on record of the petitioners.
